newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt says cancels tender for 25,000 T sugar.
newsitem.headline: Egypt says cancels tender for 25,000 T sugar.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Sugar and Integrated Industries Company cancelled a tender for 25,000 tonnes of raw or white sugar on Monday, saying it received only one bid at $326 a tonne for raw sugar.
A company official said the company might invite new bids at a later stage. Monday's tender was for October delivery.

A trader said the sole bid was from Louis Dreyfus. Other sugar dealers were not interested because the Egyptian company is imposing terms that are too onerous, especially on certification of the sugar by health authorities, he added.
